in_marathi.name: राजीव
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे King of Life
in_marathi.long_meaning: राजीव हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Rājīv is derived from the Sanskrit word 'rājīva', which translates to 'King of Life'. This name is believed to be bestowed upon those who possess the qualities of a wise and brave ruler.

in_bengali.name: राजीव

in_bengali.long_meaning: राजीव একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Rājīv is derived from the Sanskrit word 'rājīva', which translates to 'King of Life'. This name is believed to be bestowed upon those who possess the qualities of a wise and brave ruler.
